title: Check value and type
summary: PHP: Check value and type. Compare 5 with 5 instead.
introduction: The === test checks both the value and its type. Text 5 is not the same type as number 5.
learningObjectives: Check value and type with PHP

blocks.text: Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.
One 5 is numeric and one is text. Strict equality rejects that type difference.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Loose equality can convert types; === avoids that surprise.
